audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Quinn/Skill/Quinn/Quinn while the whys said Quinn owns 1-2 and Sett owns 3 onward.
audit.why: The packet chart is Quinn, Quinn, then Sett for every later row, and the mirror (quinn__sett) flipped its rows 0, 2, 3 and 6 to match — keeping first item on Quinn because both its whys and its late spike put that stage on her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 and 6 set as matched full+content pairs to Quinn, Quinn, Sett, Sett, Sett, (Quinn), Sett with ratings; row 5 already read Quinn and stays.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item spike invented a health number ('squishy 1600-ish health pool') and whys[5] gave the stage to Sett against the mirror.
audit.why: No health value is in the kit data, so the number is unverifiable. The real first-item mechanic is Heightened Senses: attack speed and move speed after she attacks a Harrier target.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] names Heightened Senses and drops the invented number; whys[5] hands the stage to Quinn as the mirror settled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind was attributed to Vault throughout ('Vault (Dash/Blind)'), and Quinn was twice called a 'dashless marksman'.
audit.why: Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) is the blind; Vault (E, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) is a dash that damages, slows and briefly interrupts, then leaps her back to attack range. She is not dashless — and that matters, because The Show Stopper GROUNDS, which is exactly what shuts Vault off. Behind Enemy Lines is also a channel your Facebreaker cancels.
audit.corrected: focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, early, mid, whys[4] and spikes[1] all corrected.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind): matchup-defining — Her self-peel. E-stun her when down. Track it before every engage. - Quinn Vault: Dashes to a target, knocks back, and blinds their next attacks. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Quinn Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11s at rank 1): the blind — it stops your autos, not Haymaker. - Quinn Vault (E, 675 range, 12s at rank 1): a dash that slows and briefly interrupts you.

edits.before: Her self-peel. E-stun her when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Vault is her self-peel, 12s at rank 1 — engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Quinn wastes Vault (Dash/Blind) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Her blind stops your autos, but Haymaker's punch still lands in full.

edits.before: Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind): Her self-peel. E-stun her when down. When it is down — E-stun + W her.
edits.after: Track Quinn's Vault: her 12s self-peel dash; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q). When down — E-stun + W her.

edits.before: R The Show Stopper at 6 is a no-counterplay flip on a dashless, escape-reliant marksman.
edits.after: The Show Stopper grounds at 6, so Vault cannot carry her out once the grab lands.

edits.before: First item makes your W true damage lethal to Quinn's squishy body while she can't burst you.
edits.after: First item is hers: Harrier procs and 1025-range poke outpace you before you reach her.

edits.before: The Show Stopper (R) is a hard answer to a champion with no dash or stun; flip her before she can kite and she has no Vault knockback ready to save herself.
edits.after: The Show Stopper grounds, so it shuts off Vault (675 range, 12s at rank 1) — and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel that your Facebreaker cancels outright.

edits.before: After first item plus boots you outrun her attack-speed steroid in short bursts, and your W true-damage core deletes her squishy 1600-ish health pool in one combo.
edits.after: After first item plus boots you close in short bursts, but Heightened Senses feeds her attack speed off Harrier procs — cash Haymaker's true centre when she is in reach.

edits.before: Quinn owns the first two levels: her Blind (Q) neutralizes your Q autos and Vault (E) knocks you back before your grit builds, so respect the poke and last-hit at range.
edits.after: Quinn owns the first two levels: Blinding Assault (Q) blanks your autos and Vault leaps her back out of reach before your grit builds, so respect the poke and farm safe.

edits.before: By level 3 the E-into-W combo gives you grit sustain and a slow she can't answer twice; once you hit 6, R is unconditional lockdown on a dashless marksman and you take over.
edits.after: By level 3 the E-into-W combo gives you grit sustain and a slow she can't answer twice; at 6 your grab grounds Vault, and Facebreaker cancels her Behind Enemy Lines channel.

notes: The mirror flagged that quinn__sett's dosFull[2].t reads 'Blind (E) his W-punch' — wrong slot and a claim the blind stops Haymaker; it is 21 characters so the applier skips it and it still needs a manual fix on the Quinn page. On this page the equivalent claim is corrected in dosFull[2].d. Quinn's R shows a 3s cooldown at 700 range in the kit: that is the recast/Skystrike value, not the ultimate's real cooldown, so no cooldown number was written for it. Packet games (534 here) disagrees with the mirror's reported packet games (367) for the same pairing — worth one look at the packet builder, though it is far above any deferral threshold either way.
